options: Would you like to drink water?
Maybe you can drink water instead.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 밑줄 친 부분과 바꾸어 쓸 수 없는 것은?

B: What is your favorite drink?
G: I love soda. I drink it every day.
B: That's bad for your health. Why don't you drink water instead?
G: OK. I'll try.
questions.explanation: "Why don't you drink water instead?"는 제안의 의미입니다. ①②③⑤는 모두 제안의 의미로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있으나, ④ "I recommend trying water instead."는 권고의 의미로 약간 다릅니다. 그러나 문맥상 가장 자연스럽지 않은 것은 ④입니다.

options: My hobby is listening to music.
The birds are flying in the sky.
That movie is now playing in the theater.
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 (A)의 쓰임과 다른 것은?

<보기>
The man is (A)selling ice cream in the park.
questions.explanation: The man is selling(현재진행형)에서 -ing는 현재 진행 중인 동작을 나타냅니다. ①②④⑤도 모두 현재진행형입니다. ③ "My hobby is listening to music"에서 -ing는 동명사로 사용되어 명사 역할을 합니다. 따라서 (A)와 다른 쓰임입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 내용으로 미루어 볼 때, <보기>의 대화 중 글을 바르게 이해하지 못한 사람은?

[지문]
Show Host: Hello, everyone! Welcome to Teens' Kitchen. Today, we have three teen chefs on the show. They're making healthy and delicious snacks, and they will tell us about them.

Bella: Ciao, I'm Bella from Italy. I'm making caprese skewers. Anyone can make these. You just need mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves. Just put them on skewers, and they'll become healthy snacks. Caprese skewers are low in calories, so I often eat them as a light snack.

Mina: Hi, I'm Mina from Korea, and I'm baking tofu chips. Unlike other chips, my tofu chips are healthy. Why? I don't fry my chips but bake them. I don't use any flour, either. I use only tofu. Eat the tofu chips with honey or garlic powder. They'll taste good.

Miguel: Hello, everyone. I'm Miguel from Brazil. I'm making an acai bowl right now. It's a thick acai berry smoothie in a bowl. You can add other healthy foods like nuts and bananas, and it'll taste really good. Acai berries are a superfood, and people all over the world enjoy them.

<보기>
소민: "Bella의 요리는 만들기가 매우 쉬운 것 같아."
지호: "Mina는 튀기는 방식이 건강에 좋지 않다고 생각하는구나."
유진: "Miguel의 요리는 아사이베리 외에 다른 재료는 넣으면 안 돼."
하준: "이 쇼는 건강과 맛을 모두 중요하게 생각하는 것 같아."
questions.explanation: 소민: Bella가 "Anyone can make these"라고 말했으므로 올바름. 지호: Mina가 "I don't fry my chips but bake them"이라고 말했으므로, 튀기는 방식이 건강에 좋지 않다고 생각함이 맞음. 유진: Miguel이 "You can add other healthy foods like nuts and bananas"라고 했으므로, 아사이베리 외에도 다른 재료를 넣을 수 있음. 유진이 잘못 이해함. 하준: 세 요리 모두 건강과 맛을 강조하므로 올바름.

questions.question:
다음 글을 아래와 같이 요약했을 때 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
I have two unhealthy habits. First, I drink too much soda. Second, I don't exercise enough. From now on, I won't drink soda, and I will drink water instead. I will also go out for a walk more often. Health is important, and I will change my bad habits.

↓

I have two unhealthy habits: drinking too much soda and ⓐ_______ enough. I will stop drinking soda and walk more often to be ⓑ_______.
questions.explanation: 원문에서 "I don't exercise enough"이므로 ⓐ는 "not exercising enough". "Health is important, and I will change my bad habits"에서 건강해지기 위함이므로 ⓑ는 "healthy"입니다.

questions.question:
대화의 흐름에 맞게 (A)~(D)를 순서대로 배열한 것은?

(A) I like basketball. I play it once a week.
(B) What is your favorite sport, Jisu?
(C) I can't. I'm too busy.
(D) Only once a week? Why don't you play more often?
questions.explanation: 대화 흐름: (B) 질문 → (A) 답변 → (D) 추가 질문 → (C) 이유 설명. 따라서 (B)-(A)-(D)-(C)가 올바른 순서입니다.

options: That dog can run very fast.
He can solve difficult math problems.
questions.question:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분과 다른 의미로 쓰인 것은?

Can you fix this car?
questions.explanation: "Can you fix this car?"는 '능력/가능'을 나타내는 요청입니다. ①④⑤는 모두 '능력/가능'을 의미하나, ② "That dog can run very fast"는 '~할 수 있다'는 능력을 나타내는 같은 의미입니다. 그러나 ① "Can I borrow your pencil?"은 '허락을 요청'하는 의미로 다릅니다. 다시 검토하면, 모두 능력의 의미이므로 정답은 ①입니다.

options: G는 일주일에 두 번 수업을 원한다.
G는 오후 5시 이후에만 수업을 들을 수 있다.
Mr. Kim의 수업은 화요일과 금요일에 있다.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

[지문]
M: Can I help you?
G: Yes, I'd like to take some badminton lessons.
M: Are you a beginner?
G: Yes, I am.
M: OK. How often do you want to take lessons?
G: Two times a week, but I can only come after 5 p.m.
M: Then why don't you take Mr. Kim's class? His class meets at 6 p.m. on Mondays and Thursdays.
G: That sounds perfect!
questions.explanation: 대화에서 "His class meets at 6 p.m. on Mondays and Thursdays."라고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 Mr. Kim의 수업은 월요일과 목요일에 있으므로, ④번 "화요일과 금요일"은 일치하지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화에서 M과 G의 관계로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
M: Can I help you?
G: Yes, I'd like to take some badminton lessons.
M: Are you a beginner?
G: Yes, I am.
M: OK. How often do you want to take lessons?
G: Two times a week, but I can only come after 5 p.m.
M: Then why don't you take Mr. Kim's class? His class meets at 6 p.m. on Mondays and Thursdays.
G: That sounds perfect!
questions.explanation: M이 G에게 "Can I help you?"라고 물으며 수업 관련 상담을 해주고, G가 수업을 등록하려는 상황입니다. 이는 상담원(M)과 수강을 원하는 학생(G)의 관계입니다.

questions.question: 두 단어의 관계가 나머지와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ①slow-fast, ②like-unlike, ③open-close, ⑤healthy-unhealthy는 모두 반대말 관계입니다. ④easy-different는 반대말 관계가 아니라 서로 다른 개념의 단어입니다.

options: He not can use a mobile phone.
They can take part in this festival.
We will visit our grandparents in Jeju.
Will he goes with his friends to the cinema?
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation:
②번: "He cannot use" 또는 "He can't use"가 올바른 형태입니다. "He not can"은 어법에 맞지 않습니다.
⑤번: will 다음에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 "Will he go with his friends to the cinema?"가 올바릅니다.
따라서 ②번과 ⑤번이 어법상 틀렸습니다.

options: They are eaten as a light snack in Italy.
They are a famous superfood from Brazil.
They use tofu, honey, and garlic powder as ingredients.
I make them by baking, not frying, and without using flour.
They become healthy snacks when put on skewers with tomatoes.
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
Bella: Ciao, I'm Bella from Italy. I'm making caprese skewers. Anyone can make these. You just need mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves. Just put them on skewers, and they'll become healthy snacks. Caprese skewers are low in calories, so I often eat them as a light snack.

Mina: Hi, I'm Mina from Korea, and I'm baking tofu chips. Unlike other chips, my tofu chips are healthy. Why? ____________________________________. I use only tofu. Eat the tofu chips with honey or garlic powder. They'll taste good.
questions.explanation: Mina가 "Why?"에 대해 설명하고 있습니다. 다음 문장이 "I use only tofu"이므로, 그 전에는 튀기지 않고 굽는다는 조리 방법의 차이를 설명해야 합니다. ④번 "I make them by baking, not frying, and without using flour."이 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 <조건>에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 7번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

[지문]
Miguel: Hello, everyone. I'm Miguel from Brazil. I'm making an acai bowl right now. It's a thick acai berry smoothie in a bowl. (A) 당신은 견과류와 바나나 같은 다른 건강한 음식들을 추가할 수 있습니다., and it'll taste really good. Acai berries are a superfood, and people all over the world enjoy them.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것
- 총 10개의 단어로 완성할 것
add / and / bananas / can / foods / healthy / like / nuts / other / you
questions.explanation:
문장: You can add other healthy foods like nuts and bananas.
단어 순서: 1.You 2.can 3.add 4.other 5.healthy 6.foods 7.like 8.nuts 9.and 10.bananas
7번째 단어는 "like"입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Miguel: Hello, everyone. I'm Miguel from Brazil. I'm making an acai bowl right now. It's a thick acai berry smoothie in a bowl. You can add other healthy foods like nuts and bananas, and it'll taste really good. Acai berries are a superfood, and people all over the world enjoy them.

Mina: Hi, I'm Mina from Korea, and I'm baking tofu chips. Unlike other chips, my tofu chips are healthy. Why? I don't fry my chips but bake them. I don't use any flour, either. I use only tofu. Eat the tofu chips with honey or garlic powder. They'll taste good.

다음 중 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 있는 질문을 있는 대로 고른 것은?

<보기>
㉠ What is an acai bowl? - 글에서 설명함
㉡ Where are Miguel and Mina from? - 글에서 언급함
㉢ Why are Mina's tofu chips healthy? - 글에서 설명함
㉣ How can we eat an acai bowl more deliciously? - 글에서 다른 음식을 추가하는 것만 언급
㉤ What does Miguel not use when he makes an acai bowl? - 글에서 언급 없음
questions.explanation:
㉠ What is an acai bowl? - 글에서 설명함 (O)
㉡ Where are Miguel and Mina from? - 글에서 언급함 (O)
㉢ Why are Mina's tofu chips healthy? - 글에서 설명함 (O)
㉣ How can we eat an acai bowl more deliciously? - 글에서 다른 음식을 추가하는 것만 언급 (X)
㉤ What does Miguel not use when he makes an acai bowl? - 글에서 언급 없음 (X)

options: ⓑ: to put something with another thing or group of things
ⓓ: to cook food in hot fat or oil
ⓔ: one or the other of two
questions.question:
[지문]
Miguel: Hello, everyone. I'm Miguel from Brazil. I'm making an acai bowl right now. It's a ⓐ thick acai berry smoothie in a bowl. You can ⓑ add other healthy foods like nuts and bananas, and it'll taste really good. Acai berries are a superfood, and people all over the world ⓒ enjoy them.

Mina: Hi, I'm Mina from Korea, and I'm baking tofu chips. Unlike other chips, my tofu chips are healthy. Why? I don't ⓓ fry my chips but bake them. I don't use any flour, ⓔ either. I use only tofu. Eat the tofu chips with honey or garlic powder. They'll taste good.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 영영풀이가 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'thick'은 '진하다, 걸쭉하다'는 의미이므로 'heavy or not flowing easily'는 적절한 정의입니다. 그러나 '진하다'는 의미에 더 가깝고, 다른 선택지들이 정확하므로 문맥상 가장 적절하지 않은 것은 ⓐ입니다.

options: I'm not tell a lie to you.
He is not picks up the trash.
What are they do in the room?
We are runing on the playground.
She isn't using the computer now.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation:
① I'm not tell → I'm not telling (현재진행형)
② He is not picks → He does not pick (단순현재)
③ What are they do → What are they doing (현재진행형)
④ We are runing → We are running (e 생략하고 n 중복)
⑤ She isn't using the computer now. (올바른 현재진행형)

options: ⓑ: mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves
ⓒ: mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves
ⓓ: mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves
questions.question:
[지문]
I'm Bella from Italy. I'm making caprese skewers. Anyone can make ⓐ these. You just need mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves. Just put ⓑ them on skewers, and ⓒ they'll become healthy snacks. Caprese skewers are low in calories, so I often eat ⓓthem as a light snack. ⓔ They are healthy and tasty!

ⓐ~ⓔ 중 지칭하는 대상이 잘못 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'them'은 'caprese skewers'를 지칭합니다. 'I often eat them as a light snack'에서 'them'은 만들어진 caprese skewers를 먹는 것이므로, mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves가 아닙니다.

questions.question:
<보기>에서 영영풀이를 찾을 수 없는 단어는?

<보기>
- a small meal between main meals
- a person who cooks professionally
- not heavy or not difficult to digest
- sweet liquid made by bees
questions.explanation:
• a small meal between main meals = snack
• a person who cooks professionally = chef
• not heavy or not difficult to digest = light
• sweet liquid made by bees = honey
'fry'의 영영풀이가 <보기>에 없습니다.

options: Can your brother ride a bike?
Can you write a diary in English?
Can you help me with this trash can?
Can you climb the tree in the garden?
questions.question: 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 나머지와 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ①, ②, ③, ⑤는 '~할 수 있니?'라는 능력이나 가능성을 묻는 의미입니다. ④는 '~을 도와줄 수 있니?'라는 부탁의 의미입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
B: Are you a member at this gym, Amy?
G: Yes, I am. I like working out.
B: How often do you work out?
G: I work out ________________.

대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'How often do you work out?'에는 '얼마나 자주'에 대한 빈도를 나타내는 표현이 답입니다. 'last weekend'는 과거의 특정 시간을 나타내므로 적절하지 않습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
M: Can I help you?
G: Yes, I'd like to take some badminton lessons.
M: Are you a beginner?
G: Yes, I am.
M: OK. (가) How often do you want to take lessons?
G: Two times a week, but I can only come after 5 p.m.
M: Then why don't you take Mr. Kim's class? His class meets at 6 p.m. on Mondays and Thursdays.
G: That sounds perfect!

밑줄 친 (가)를 말한 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'How often do you want to take lessons?'라는 질문을 통해 여자의 수업 빈도를 파악하고, 그 이후 'Mr. Kim's class'를 추천합니다. 따라서 여자의 조건에 맞는 수업을 추천하기 위해 필요한 정보를 수집하는 목적입니다.

options: He is lieing on the bed.
He is carring a heavy box.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 동사의 -ing형이 바르게 쓰인 것은?
questions.explanation:
① listening (correct)
② writting → writing (t 하나만)
③ lieing → lying (e 생략)
④ studing → studying (y → i로 변경)
⑤ carring → carrying (r 중복)

options: a lot of / bad / put in
a lot of / good / leave out
questions.question:
[지문]
Bella: Ciao, I'm Bella from Italy. I'm making caprese skewers. Anyone can make these. You just need mozzarella cheese, cherry tomatoes, and basil leaves. Just put them on skewers, and they'll become healthy snacks. Caprese skewers have (A) [ few / a lot of ] calories, so I often eat them as a light snack.

Mina: Hi, I'm Mina from Korea, and I'm baking tofu chips. Unlike other chips, my tofu chips are (B) [ good / bad ] for your health. Why? I don't fry my chips but bake them. I don't use any flour, either. I use only tofu. Eat the tofu chips with honey or garlic powder. They'll taste good.

Miguel: Hello, everyone. I'm Miguel from Brazil. I'm making an acai bowl right now. It's a thick acai berry smoothie in a bowl. You can (C) [ put in / leave out ] other healthy foods like nuts and bananas, and it'll taste really good. Acai berries are a superfood, and people all over the world enjoy them.

다음 글의 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation:
(A) 'Caprese skewers are low in calories'이므로 'a lot of'가 아닌 'few'가 맞습니다.
(B) 'healthy snacks'이고 'unlike other chips, my tofu chips are healthy'이므로 'good'이 맞습니다.
(C) 'You can add other healthy foods'는 '추가할 수 있다'는 의미이므로 'put in'이 맞습니다.

options:
A: What do you do every morning?
B: I read the newspaper online.

A: Is she reading a book right now?
B: Yes, she isn't.

A: Does he listen to music at school?
B: No, he doesn't like playing baseball.

A: What are you doing here on the sofa?
B: Do your homework right now.

A: Do you exercise regularly in the gym?
B: I will visit my uncle.
questions.question: 대화의 흐름이 자연스러운 것은?
questions.explanation:
① A의 질문과 B의 답변이 자연스럽게 연결됩니다.
② 'Yes, she isn't'는 모순입니다. 'Yes'이면 'she is'여야 합니다.
③ B의 답변이 A의 질문과 무관합니다.
④ B의 명령문이 A의 질문과 어색합니다.
⑤ B의 답변이 A의 질문과 무관합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, everyone. I'm Miguel from Brazil. I'm making an acai bowl right now. It's a ⓐ thick acai berry smoothie in a bowl. You can ⓑ add other healthy foods like nuts and bananas, and it'll taste really ⓒ bad. Acai berries are a ⓓ harmful food, and people all over the world ⓔ enjoy them.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것들로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation:
ⓐ thick - 적절 (진하다는 의미)
ⓑ add - 적절 (추가하다)
ⓒ bad - 부적절 ('taste really good'이어야 함)
ⓓ harmful - 부적절 ('superfood'이라고 했으므로 유해한 음식이 아님)
ⓔ enjoy - 적절 (즐기다)
따라서 ⓒ와 ⓓ가 문맥상 적절하지 않습니다.
